name: Nolzur's Marvelous Pigments

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Paint

params.text: paints an object of up to 1,000 cubic feet into reality

powers.text: It paints an object of up to 1,000 cubic feet into reality. (No other effect in the game.)

summary: Paint objects (a door, a bridge, a tree) and they become real.
text: Whatever you paint flat with these pigments becomes a real, solid thing: focus on the image and the paint streams off the brush to shape it. They usually come as 1d4 pots in a fine wooden case with a brush. One pot covers 1,000 square feet of surface, enough to make inanimate objects or terrain features whose combined volume is no more than 10,000 cubic feet. Nothing made this way can be worth more than 25 GP. (Our game lets the party paint a door, a ladder or a bridge wherever the story permits.)
